sources.snippet: SatelliteVision-Base (SatVis-B) is a pre-trained vision transformer based on the SwinV2 model architecture. The model is pre-trained on global MODIS surface reflectance data from which 1.99 million image chips were used. sources.title: GitHub - nasa-nccs-hpda/satvision-pix4d-cloud: SatVision PIX4D
sources.snippet: SatVision-PIX4D is a scalable data generation and pre-training pipeline for geostationary satellite imagery, designed to support self-supervised and foundation-model development using ABI L1 data. The system is optimized for execution on NASA NCCS HPC resources using Singularity containers and supports stratified tile generation (e.g., convection, cloud systems, land cover).
